罗迪走后，我解除了末日战刀的盔甲状态，露出了我英俊的面庞。

其实刘鼎天心里也是不甘心的，很明显蓝慕梅处事更偏向家族，毕竟自己只是一介散修，对蓝滕宫的帮助不及他们。

“他们并没有看错，这件事不要再提了。”众人正商讨着的时候，之前火梧宗的两个天权高手已被阵法放了出来，见到众人在此，则是靠拢了过来。

“这尼玛是咋回事？思雨和林初夏怎么来了？”说实话，云尘是有些懵逼的。

但是阮苍穹的话还没说完，塔哈克和特勒卡尔就瞬间变了脸色。只见塔哈克突然哼了一声，身上的气势狂涌，周围那些侍卫模样的人感受到这股气势，全都像是接收到什么命令似的，齐齐围了过来。

云尘一愣，转过头看去，却发现杨三石正对着他使劲的招手，声音正是从他的口中传出来的。

“刑场之上的变故在下自然是知道的，但那与我又有何关系？大人，你可不要冤枉无辜哪。我谢景昌向来遵纪守法，岂会做出这等事来？”谢景昌的回答毫不犹豫。

“没关系，我化化妆就是了，这样就谁都认不出来了。”羽灵调皮的说道。

一一和巫格云星拉着王玲伟劝解她，刘显赵季等人也拉着赵晓枫和王德广劝解。

这一觉又一觉睡的很不踏实，但齐浩的状态却是越来越好，最少他已经不觉得自己很累，只是力气还是不算大。

这才是他无比愤怒的原因。万剑门莫说拿住王伦了，反而被王伦直接挑衅，堂堂长老都被王伦弄没，万剑门颜面丢尽。

这倒是意外，往前来了新任，哪怕是长官，队伍里也多多少少会出现不服气的声音，可是这回，有的只有热切和期盼。

实际上，空置的王爷府，并不像宋雨花坚定的脚步给人的感觉那么牢靠，宋雨花刚刚让野兽去打探消息，得知，这偌大的庭院内，还守着一些人。

After Roddy left, I disarmed the Doomsday Saber and revealed my handsome face.

In fact, Liu Dingtian was unwilling to do so. It was obvious that Lan Mumei was more family-oriented in dealing with matters. After all, he was just a casual cultivator and could not help Lan Teng Palace as much as they did.

"They are not wrong. Don't mention this matter again." While everyone was discussing, the two Tianquan masters from the Fire Wu Sect had been released by the formation. Seeing everyone here, they came closer.

"What's going on? Why are Siyu and Lin Chuxia here?" To be honest, Yun Chen was a little confused.

But before Ruan Cangqiong finished speaking, Tahak and Telekar's expressions instantly changed.Tahak suddenly snorted, and the aura on his body surged wildly. The people who looked like guards around him felt the aura, and they all gathered around as if they had received some order.

Yun Chen was stunned and turned his head to look, only to find that Yang Sanshi was waving at him vigorously, and the voice came from his mouth.

"Of course I know what happened on the execution ground, but what does that have to do with me? Sir, please don't accuse innocent people unjustly. I, Xie Jingchang, have always obeyed the law, how could I do such a thing?" Xie Jingchang answered without hesitation.

"It doesn't matter, I'll just put on makeup so no one can recognize me." Yu Ling said mischievously.

Yiyi and Wuge Yunxing pulled Wang Lingwei to persuade her, while Liu Xian, Zhao Ji and others also pulled Zhao Xiaofeng and Wang Deguang to persuade her.

He had a restless sleep after another, but Qi Hao's condition was getting better and better. At least he no longer felt tired, but his strength was still not very strong.

This was the reason why he was extremely angry.Not only did Wanjianmen capture Wang Lun, but they were directly provoked by Wang Lun. All the dignified elders were killed by Wang Lun, and Wanjianmen lost all face.

This is unexpected. When a new officer comes forward, even if he is a commander, there will be more or less dissatisfied voices in the team, but this time, there is only enthusiasm and expectation.

In fact, the vacant Prince's Mansion is not as solid as Song Yuhua's firm footsteps make people feel. Song Yuhua just asked the beast to inquire about the news and learned that there are still some people guarding the huge courtyard.
